package.name: sam_farm_inspection
package.description:
Autonomous algae-farm inspection for SAM: side-scan rope/buoy detection (sensors-22-05064 section 5), farm localization against a prior (section 6), and the lane geometry the inspection is flown on.
Two nodes, one package: `sss_farm_detector` and `farm_localizer` share the farm prior loader, the side-scan geometry model and the protective-stop envelope, and splitting them into two ament packages would have meant either duplicating those three modules or inventing a third package to hold them.
The farm prior itself is NOT in this package. It is generated from the site's own measurements by data-cube/scripts/kristineberg-site/make_farm_prior.py and read at runtime, so a node never carries farm constants (spec section 7, single sources).
